notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout (Shopify, no WAF), same as prior Home-Decor pass. Discovery: enumerated all 95 entries from /collections.json and keyword-matched title against new/arriv/latest/recent/just in - found handles 'new-arrivals' (title 'New Arrivals', linked 3x from homepage) and 'latest-collection' (title 'Latest Collection', not present anywhere in homepage HTML - found only via the collections.json sitemap enumeration, not via visible nav). Both confirmed as real browsable Shopify collection PLPs via /collections/<handle>/products.json (standard product-grid template, not editorial/lookbook). Overlap check: the 2 products in 'Latest Collection' (ANKUR SLOF DESIGNER WALL LIGHT; ANKUR JASPER GOLDEN CAGE BLACK FINISH METAL AND CONCRETE HANGING) have zero title overlap with the 309 products in 'New Arrivals' - genuinely different listings, kept as separate rows per brief section 3 rather than treating one as an alias. Qty method: raw 'products_count' field on this Shopify site is known-inflated (per prior Home-Decor pass for this company); used exhaustive paging of products.json?limit=250 to exhaustion, deduped by product id, for both. new-arrivals: raw field=328 vs exhaustive=309. latest-collection: raw field=3 vs exhaustive=2 (one id in the raw count did not resolve to an actual returned product on any page). 'Latest Collection' is flagged per the brief's Collection-page rule below - it is a genuine tiny collection (2 SKUs) with generic marketing copy ('Discover the latest lights for your home...') and is not surfaced in the live nav/homepage, so its status as a true 'recently added' feed (vs. a small curated showcase) could not be confirmed with certainty this pass.
